description: His Majesty King Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuck announces the creation of Gelephu Mindfulness City during the 116th National Day address.
The Royal Charter is issued, formally establishing the legal and administrative autonomy of the region.
Global unveiling of the master plan by Bjarke Ingels Group (BIG) and discussions with international economic experts.
His Majesty outlines the 20-year roadmap based on a 'One Country, Two Systems' model during the 117th National Day.
His Majesty grants GMC Law No. 1 at Punakha Dzong, establishing the autonomous legal code and governance system.
Launch of domestic funding bonds alongside physical construction for Gelephu International Airport and initial urban sector engineering.
